SEND-DATAONLY-ALARM: SEND-DATAONLY-ALARM is a condition name for the SEND-FLAG variable, indicating a specific state where data should be sent to the screen along with an alarm sound.

3 - Send data to the screen and trigger an alarm sound. (see src/base/cobol_src/BNKMENU.cbl:52: 88 SEND-DATAONLY-ALARM VALUE '3'.)
    
Used in the following paths:

src/base/cobol_src/BNKMENU.cbl
src/base/cobol_src/BNK1UAC.cbl

WS-TIME-NOW: WS-TIME-NOW is a variable that holds the current time in the format HHMMSS (hours, minutes, seconds). It is used to store and manipulate time data within the application.


    
Used in the following paths:

SEND-ERASE: SEND-ERASE is a condition name for the SEND-FLAG variable, which is used to control the behavior of the CICS SEND MAP command in COBOL programs. Specifically, it indicates whether the map should be sent with the ERASE option, which clears any existing data on the screen before displaying the new map.

1 - Indicates that the map should be sent with the ERASE option, clearing any existing data on the screen before displaying the new map. (see src/base/cobol_src/BNKMENU.cbl:50: 88 SEND-ERASE VALUE '1'.)
    
Used in the following paths:

src/base/cobol_src/BNK1UAC.cbl

ABNDINFO-REC: ABNDINFO-REC is a variable used to store abend (abnormal end) information in the CICS Bank Sample Application. It is used to capture and pass information related to program failures or errors.

ABNDPROC - This value indicates the program name used for abend processing. (see src/base/cobol_src/BNK1DAC.cbl:161: 161        01 WS-ABEND-PGM                 PIC X(8) VALUE 'ABNDPROC'.)

0 - No additional information or not applicable. (see src/base/cobol_src/DELACC.cbl:292: MOVE ZERO       TO ABND-RESP2CODE)

WS-CICS-RESP: WS-CICS-RESP is a variable used to capture the response code from CICS (Customer Information Control System) commands. It is used to determine the outcome of a CICS command, such as whether it was successful or if an error occurred.

DFHRESP(NOTFINISHED) - The operation is not finished. (see src/base/cobol_src/CRECUST.cbl:657: 657                  IF WS-CICS-RESP = DFHRESP(NOTFINISHED) AND)
DFHRESP(INVREQ) - The request is invalid. (see src/base/cobol_src/CRECUST.cbl:747: 747                  IF WS-CICS-RESP = DFHRESP(INVREQ) AND)
DFHRESP(NORMAL) - The operation completed normally. (see src/base/cobol_src/CRECUST.cbl:1316: 1316              IF WS-CICS-RESP IS NOT = DFHRESP(NORMAL))
DFHRESP(NOTFND) - The requested item was not found. (see src/base/cobol_src/INQCUST.cbl:339: 339            IF (WS-CICS-RESP = DFHRESP(NOTFND))
DFHRESP(MAPFAIL) - The map operation failed. (see src/base/cobol_src/BNKMENU.cbl:284: 284               IF WS-CICS-RESP = DFHRESP(MAPFAIL))
DFHRESP(SYSIDERR) - A system ID error occurred. (see src/base/cobol_src/CRECUST.cbl:1039: 1039            IF WS-CICS-RESP = DFHRESP(SYSIDERR))
